You can place an article in a '''category''' by adding the string <nowiki>[[Category:</nowiki>''Example''<nowiki>]]</nowiki> to the article's text (where ''Example'' is the name of the category). A list of categories may be found at [[Special:Categories]].

The category feature has several functions:

==Sort keys==
All articles in a given category are sorted alphabetically. If you want an article to be sorted by something other than its name, you should use the following link form in the article's text: <nowiki>[[Category:</nowiki>''Example''<nowiki>|</nowiki>''Sort key''<nowiki>]]</nowiki> (where ''Example'' is the category name, and ''Sort key'' is the value to sort the list by).

For example, by default, the article [[Rand al'Thor]] will be listed under the character's first name, "R", because it is the first letter of the article's name.  You could instead force the article to be listed by the character's last name ("Al'Thor, Rand") by using the string <nowiki>[[Category:Male|Al'Thor, Rand]]</nowiki>. In this case, as with others who have a name beginning with a lowercase letter, make sure you capitalize it for sorting purposes. This is because the sort keys are case sensitive, with capital letters being sorted before lowercase letters. If this isn't done, Rand and others will be sorted after the "Z" heading.

Our characters are automatically added to various categories based on the parameters set in the {{tl|Character}} template. Because of this, changing the sort key of a character requires that we use a wiki magic word. The format for this is <nowiki>{{DEFAULTSORT:LAST NAME, FIRST NAME}}</nowiki>. This should be placed at the bottom of the page. For most characters, this is fairly straight forward. However, some characters have more interesting names based on nationality differences. Listed below is the standard format for those people.

*The Sea Folk will be alphabetized by the name that comes after "din", not their "salt name" (e.g. Zaida din Parede Blackwing would be categorized as "Parede Blackwing, Zaida din"). 
*Illianers will who have three names will be alphabetized by the name that comes before "den" (e.g. Mattin Stepaneos den Balgar would be categorized as "Stepaneos den Balgar, Mattin"). 
*Married Saldaean women will be alphabetized under their husband's last name, without the prefix (e.g. Deira ni Ghaline t'Bashere would be categorized as "Bashere, Deira ni Ghaline"). 
*People from the Age of Legends that have three names will be sorted under their second name. This is their surname and the third name is an honorific. (e.g. Lews Therin Telamon would be categorized as "Therin, Lews." Putting the honorific after their first name isn't required, but if done, won't cause any problems.)

==Linking to a category==
In order to link to a category without the current article being added to that category, place a colon before the word "Category" inside the link.

Example: <nowiki>[[:Category:Male]]</nowiki>
[[Category:Help|{{PAGENAME}}]]
